_comment: The channels every server makes for itself (docs/design/chat-channels.md section 4). Compiled into the relay (src/relay/default_channels.rs, include_str!): a server that follows releases gets the set its release was built with. Each channel: id (also its first name; an admin may rename the name); description, a word key in data/i18n/en.json, made into this server's words when the channel is made; read_level and post_level (docs/design/chat-access.md); position, lower is higher in the list; local_only, never bridged to another server; federated, travels to linked servers (only a channel anyone may read ever does); voice; and made: 'always' (made at every start when missing, so it cannot be gone for good; a local_only one while Server Settings' guaranteed local room is on and no local-only channel is left) or 'once' (made the first time this server starts with it in the set; one an admin deleted stays deleted, BUG-036). A channel already there keeps whatever its admin set.
